=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_merge_train.py:1256-1305 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The two mid-listing status-transition tests build their run with `created_at: _run_created_at(0)`. `_run_created_at` at lines 1384-1386 returns a fixed date of 2026-09-30, about 1090h old. `_run()` at lines 251-254 pops ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS, so the 24h default applies. When the run is listed as "queued", the new filter in `_mt_inflight_review_branches` treats it as wedged and releases PR 4077 instead of holding it.
  WHY: This is a proven CI failure. [waiting-queued] fails in tests-system-python (2) and [statuses4] fails in tests-system-python (3) and tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, with "ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED run=5000 workflow=.github/workflows/internal-review.yml age_h=1090 guard=merge_train_release". Fix: pass ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS="0", as line 3058 already does. Severity disagreement: four reviewers say BLOCKER, openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR; the highest is used.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:951-954 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_zombie_filter_can_be_disabled patches `_ZOMBIE_LIB_STATE["hours"]=0` before the lazy `_zombie_lib()` load. The load overwrites the patch with 24, so the 200h queued run is ignored. On teardown `hours` is restored to 0 while `loaded` stays True, so later tests run with the filter off.
  WHY: This is a proven CI failure in orchestrate-poll (4) and tests-system-python (16): "assert set() == {4}" at tests/test_unblock_scan.py:954. It also makes results depend on test order. Fix: call scan._zombie_lib() before patching, as tests/test_ci_cancelled_rerun.py does. Severity disagreement: four reviewers say BLOCKER, openai_gpt-6-luna says MAJOR; the highest is used.
- tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py:4286-4289 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Only one blank line separates test_log_zombie_run_ignored_dedupes_per_guard from `if __name__ == "__main__":` (E305).
  WHY: The pre-push gate lists ruff among the failures caused by this change. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from four reviewers, NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, which notes that the CI ruff step (ci.yml:432) does not lint tests/ and that E3xx rules are preview-only.
- tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_stale_queued.py:335-339,396-399 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Moving the `if __name__ == "__main__"` block left too many consecutive blank lines at the seams (E303).
  WHY: Ruff is reported as failing on the pushed head. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from four reviewers, NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash flags only lines 336-338 and says the 396-398 seam is fine.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1363-1404 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Logging runs only against PLAN_RUNS_JSON, and `PLAN_ZQ_LOGGED=1` stops it after the first hit. Wedged queued runs that the page-walk filter at line 1399 drops on later pages, or on later polling iterations, are therefore never logged.
  WHY: This breaks the "Each ignored run produces one searchable log line" contract and hides the suppression. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 says MAJOR, the others say NIT; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1363-1373 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PLAN_ZQ_LINES log pre-filter selects only `.display_title == $title`. It lacks the `select(.name | test("Plan"; "i"))` filter that the counting filter applies at lines 1373 and 1399.
  WHY: Wedged runs from other workflows that share the display title get logged as guard=stable_gate_plan_runs even though the guard never counted them, which misleads the audit trail.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2487-2506 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_zombie_run_created_epoch` calls `_parse_iso8601_to_epoch`, which accepts offset ("+08:00") and naive timestamps. The Bash twin, `zombie_queued_jq_def` (`fromdateiso8601`), rejects them.
  WHY: The same run JSON gets a different verdict in the Python and Bash guards, which contradicts the single shared rule in which an unparseable created_at stays active. It is reachable only with non-GitHub input.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2512-2534 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS parser (regex `[0-9]{1,5}`) has no upper bound in either the Python helper or the Bash `zombie_queued_cutoff_epoch`.
  WHY: An operator typo or hostile env value can push the cutoff arbitrarily, which the reviewer says can disable every active-run guard.
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:106-126 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_ZOMBIE_LIB_STATE["hours"]` is cached on the first `_zombie_lib()` load and never re-read from the env. The Bash twin re-reads the env on every call.
  WHY: Exporting the ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS=0 kill switch mid-process is ignored by the Python guards (unblock scan, ci cancelled rerun) but honoured by the Bash guards, so the kill switch behaves asymmetrically.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:3076-3103 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `zombie_queued_log_ignored` swallows jq failures with `2>/dev/null || true` and emits no diagnostic on malformed stdin.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell "no wedged runs" apart from "could not parse listing".
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:3037-3103 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new zombie_queued_* helpers, and the Python `_ZOMBIE_LIB_STATE`, `_ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED_SEEN` and `_zombie_lib`, add unprefixed names to the shared namespace of every script that sources or imports them.
  WHY: A future caller could shadow or redefine these names and silently disable the wedged-queued filter.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:~2417 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `autofix_inflight_peer` logging runs over the whole response before the review-family path filter.
  WHY: It can log runs the guard never counts, which misattributes the contractual log line.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh (changed shell scripts in this PR generally) | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports shellcheck as failing on this change, but the violation could not be mapped to a line from the provided artifacts.
  WHY: If real, the lint gate fails on merge. Shellcheck must be rerun over the changed shell scripts and workflow run-blocks to locate the violation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
